notices.title: Heavy Rain and Hazardous Coastal Conditions
notices.body: Heavy rain and gale-force marine conditions are expected tonight through Wednesday. Waves and storm surge are not reflected in predicted tides, so stay well within tide limits. Creeks may become impassable—use cable cars and be prepared to wait 24+ hours for water levels to recede.

notices.title: Cancellation and Delay Options
notices.body: Due to forecast heavy rain, Parks Canada is offering refunds and delayed starts for affected hikers. [Full details](https://www.facebook.com/share/p/1YSmLsyrzG/)

notices.title: Campfire Ban in Effect
notices.body: A [fire ban](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/bc/pacificrim/bulletins/a0ecce7a-e78a-4271-bd96-58c8bbf9c914) is in effect for the West Coast Trail starting July 16th at noon until further notice. No campfires are allowed, but backpacking propane stoves are permitted.

notices.title: Bear in area warning
notices.body: Parks Canada issued a [Warning notice](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/bc/pacificrim/bulletins/7947b16d-253e-4fcd-a2a5-7fb33efc429c) for bear activity between Pachena Bay and Darling River.

warnings.title: Wasp Nest
warnings.text: Active wasp nest close to barrel at highpoint, most likely ground nest.

warnings.title: Wasp Nest
warnings.text: Wasp nest in ground just a foot off the trail about 100m north of KM73 ladders.
Thin hornet nest in the cliffside brush 20m from south side of suspension bridge.

warnings.title: Confusing Trail
warnings.text: When going southbound, watch out for the trail after crossing log jam. It gets confusing where the real trail is, it climbs up on your left.
Single rung missing half way up.
